name: RockV2
description: The default theme for the RockV2.

fields.name: Primary Color
fields.description: The primary color used to highlight screen elements, such as the main button.

fields.name: Site Logo
fields.description: The logo that will be displayed throughout the site. For best results, use a white SVG file to ensure clear and consistent display across the site.

fields.name: Glass Nav
fields.description: Glass styling for the navigation. This gives the nav Child Pages panel a translucent glass background while it is open.
fields.onContent: :root { --nav-glass-blur: blur(20px) saturate(160%); --nav-glass-gap: 8px; --nav-glass-bridge-width: 16px; --nav-glass-radius: 14px; --nav-glass-rail-radius: 0 0 12px 12px; --nav-glass-brand-radius: var(--rounded-large) var(--rounded-large) 0 0; --nav-glass-border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.4); --nav-glass-shadow: inset 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85), inset -1px -1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.35), var(--popup-box-shadow); --nav-glass-item-color: var(--color-interface-stronger); --nav-glass-item-hover-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-interface-strong) 6%, transparent); --nav-glass-item-hover-color: var(--nav-glass-item-color); --nav-glass-item-active-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary) 13%, transparent); --nav-glass-item-active-color: var(--color-primary); --nav-glass-rail-active-border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.30); --nav-glass-rail-hover-width: 100%; --nav-glass-rail-hover-radius: var(--rounded-medium); --nav-glass-flyout-opacity: 0; --nav-glass-flyout-transform: translateX(-8px); --nav-glass-flyout-transition: opacity 140ms linear, transform 260ms ease-out, display 260ms allow-discrete; --nav-glass-header-color: var(--color-interface-strong); } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([theme]), [theme=system] { --nav-glass-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-interface-soft) 55%, transparent); --nav-glass-border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-interface-strongest) 22%, transparent); --nav-glass-shadow: inset 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16), inset -1px -1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07), var(--popup-box-shadow); --nav-glass-blur: blur(20px) saturate(160%); } } [theme=dark] { --nav-glass-bg: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-interface-soft) 55%, transparent); --nav-glass-border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-interface-strongest) 22%, transparent); --nav-glass-shadow: inset 1px 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.16), inset -1px -1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07), var(--popup-box-shadow); --nav-glass-blur: blur(20px) saturate(160%); } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { :root { --nav-glass-flyout-opacity: 1; --nav-glass-flyout-transform: none; --nav-glass-flyout-transition: none; } }
